sources.verification: First-subword loss versus continuation conversion B→I, special and padding labels. Checked shape 14×7 and 11 active positions for realistic WordPiece pieces.
Flat versus nested span representation; six contiguous interval candidates for three words. The original figure illustrates containment rather than asserting a general biological annotation schema.

tokenizer.method: Ran longest-match WordPiece using the pinned vocabulary for the exact ASCII example. BERT normalizer is cased, and no weights or inference were needed.

verification.whole_read: Complete Russian and English chapter read against the cited source sections and examples. Neighbouring BERT and T5 chapters changed only in navigation and canonical-revision pins.
verification.example: Executed the shared Python block. Checked first-piece and all-piece labels, gold and predicted character intervals, valid and invalid IOB2 paths, and exact span scoring. Independent test reproduces 97/100 token accuracy with F1=0 and F1=1/3 after restoring one mention.

verification.visual: Opened the final RU and EN pages in Chromium at 390 and 1440 CSS pixels. Both source figures decoded and were inspected in the layout.
